nodes.name: The Untold History of AI
nodes.summary: Part 6 lesson (order 2) tracing the 'displaced prerequisites' that made AI physically and intellectually possible: the cosmological and evolutionary chain from the Big Bang to life, the mythos-to-logos intellectual revolutions (probability, Boolean logic, information theory), the material foundations (metallurgy, electricity, optics, insulation), hardware, war/space research, and data-abstraction and web history, all framed as contributions that vanish into the background beneath modern LLMs.
nodes.languageNotes: Static prose lesson: a COURSE_METADATA header followed by many <div class="md"> Markdown blocks rendered client-side; ~200 LaTeX-style \cite macros processed at runtime by bibtexify(); dozens of <figure>/<figcaption> image credits; no interactive widget.
